class.name: VFXBudgetServer
class.brief_description: Global effect and particle budget scaled by quality tier.
class.description: [VFXBudgetServer] is available as the engine singleton [code]VFXBudgetServer[/code]. It limits how many effects and particles may be alive at once, per category and globally, and scales those limits by a quality [member tier]. A request is admitted when it fits all caps. Otherwise it may evict live effects of lower value, where value is the priority divided by [code]1 + distance * distance_falloff[/code]. Evicted effects are reported through [signal evicted]. Requests farther from the camera than [method get_max_distance] are always rejected. Default categories (limits are [code]max_effects / max_particles[/code] for the Medium tier): [code]combat[/code] 24 / 2400, [code]ambient[/code] 16 / 1600, [code]weather[/code] 6 / 3000, [code]environment[/code] 12 / 2000 and [code]ui[/code] 8 / 400. Unknown categories get 8 / 800. The tier scales limits by 0.4 (Low), 1.0 (Medium), 1.75 (High) and 3.0 (Ultra). [VFXGraphInstance3D] talks to this server automatically when its [member VFXGraphInstance3D.budget_category] is set.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets all live effects without emitting [signal evicted].

method.name: get_active_effects
method.description: Returns the number of live effects in [param category], or in total if it is empty.

method.name: get_active_particles
method.description: Returns the particle cost of live effects in [param category], or in total if it is empty.

method.name: get_last_id
method.description: Returns the id granted by the last [method request_id] call (0 if it was rejected).

method.name: get_max_distance
method.description: Returns the maximum camera distance accepted for the current tier (40, 70, 110 or 160).

method.name: get_max_effects
method.description: Returns the effect cap of [param category] for the current tier.

method.name: get_max_particles
method.description: Returns the particle cap of [param category] for the current tier.

method.name: get_max_total_particles
method.description: Returns the global particle cap for the current tier ([member global_particle_base] times the tier scale).

method.name: has_category
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param category] has explicit limits.

method.name: is_live
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the effect [param id] is still admitted.

method.name: release
method.description: Releases the slot of effect [param id]. Unknown ids are ignored.

method.name: request
method.description: Like [method request_id] but only returns whether the effect was admitted. Use [method get_last_id] to fetch the id.

method.name: request_id
method.description: Requests a slot for an effect that costs [param cost] particles. Returns the effect id (greater than 0) or 0 if rejected. Lower value effects may be evicted to make room.

method.name: reset_stats
method.description: Resets the counters reported by [method get_stats].

method.name: set_category_limits
method.description: Adds or overrides a category. The values are Medium tier numbers; other tiers scale them.

method.name: value_of
method.description: Returns the keep-value of an effect: [param priority] discounted by the distance to the camera.

members.member: How quickly the value of an effect drops with camera distance.
Global particle cap at the Medium tier.

signal.name: evicted
signal.description: Emitted when a live effect was evicted to make room for a more valuable request.

constants.constant: Lowest quality: limits are scaled by 0.4.
Default quality: limits are used as authored.
